name: Altamira Jogja Istimewa 2015

venue.name: Griya Kedaulatan Rakyat (KR)
venue.details: Go south from "Tugu Yogyakarta". The venue is on the left side of the street.

information: This official competition goes by the name of Altamira Jogja Istimewa 2015, in correspond to the launch of the new Jogja Istimewa logo and in cooperation with Altamira Sport Management. This event will be held simultaneously with the end of National Exam for 12th graders. For more info you can contact Bintang (+628562963666), Kevin (+6287738957887), and Bogi (+6285729275561)
